name: KRN brain layer boundary
decision: KRN should behave as a governed RAG, memory, source, review, and feedback layer around Codex execution: Codex executes, while KRN selects bounded context, exposes source-grounded evidence, records proof boundaries, and keeps workers as candidate-only maintenance contracts until the human-deferred plnv executor decision. Workers are not Codex exec; they are candidate maintenance contracts. The naming standard is no vanity rename: apply the helper extraction rule only when it removes duplication, names a reviewed domain concept, moves boundary logic, or reduces unsafe casts/parser drift.
consumers: future brain/search planning queries about workers and Codex execution boundaries
future kernel roadmap selection after cleanup waves
falsifier: A future plan, brief, or brain/search readback treats workers as Codex execution, claims worker runtime enforcement before plnv is explicitly un-deferred, performs a vanity naming sweep without review-cost evidence, or extracts helpers that do not remove duplication, name a domain concept, move boundary logic, or reduce unsafe casts/parser drift.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove retrieval ranking quality, source truth, worker runtime, product readiness, or that every current KRN file already follows the brain layer model.
